title: Shimla Tour Package
overview: Three days in the Queen of Hills, driven door to door from Delhi. Evenings on Mall Road and The Ridge, a full day at Kufri and Green Valley, and the colonial landmarks Shimla is known for — Christ Church, Jakhoo Temple and the Viceregal Lodge. Short enough for a long weekend, unhurried enough that you are not eating breakfast in the car.
highlights: The Ridge, Mall Road and Christ Church on the first evening
A full day at Kufri and Green Valley for mountain views and photography
Jakhoo Temple on Jakhoo Hill, with views over the whole valley
Private cab from Delhi and back, with tolls and parking included
Snowfall possible at Kufri between late December and February
inclusions: Private cab for all transfers and sightseeing, Delhi to Delhi
Travel assistance on WhatsApp for the length of the trip
exclusions: Entry tickets at monuments and viewpoints
Adventure activities at Kufri (horse riding, yak rides, ropeway, snow activities)
Lunch, dinner and any premium meal plan
Anything not specifically listed under inclusions

itinerary.title: Delhi to Shimla, arrival and Mall Road
itinerary.description: Depart Delhi early by private cab for the drive up through the Shivalik foothills. Check in and rest, then head out in the evening to The Ridge, Mall Road and Christ Church — the pedestrian stretch at the heart of Shimla, best walked slowly with time for the cafés and shops.
itinerary.morningActivity: Private cab from Delhi through the Shivalik hills
itinerary.eveningActivity: The Ridge, Mall Road and Christ Church on foot

itinerary.title: Kufri, Green Valley and Jakhoo Temple
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive out to Kufri and Green Valley for the mountain views and the forested ridgelines these two are known for. Later, visit Jakhoo Temple on Jakhoo Hill. The evening is free again on Mall Road and The Ridge.
itinerary.insiderTip: Jakhoo involves a steep walk — wear proper shoes, and keep phones and food packets out of sight, the monkeys are practised at both.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Delhi, departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast, check out, and the drive back to Delhi by private cab with refreshment stops along the way. The tour ends on arrival in Delhi.
itinerary.morningActivity: Check out and begin the return drive

faqs.question: How many days are enough for a Shimla trip?
faqs.answer: Three to four days covers Shimla's main attractions and Kufri without rushing, which is why this package is built as 3 days and 2 nights. Two days would be mostly road — Shimla is roughly 7 to 8 hours from Delhi each way. If you have a week, we can extend this into Manali, Solang Valley and the Atal Tunnel.

faqs.question: What does this Shimla package cost?
faqs.answer: ₹7,500 per person on twin sharing, which works out to about ₹15,000 for a couple, plus 5% GST. That covers 2 nights hotel with breakfast, the private cab from Delhi and back, tolls, parking and all the sightseeing listed. The figure moves with your travel dates, hotel category and group size — New Year and the summer holidays are the dearest weeks of the year in Shimla.

faqs.question: Is this Shimla package good for a family?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it is deliberately paced for one. The sightseeing sits in two easy days rather than four packed ones, Mall Road is pedestrian so children can walk freely, and Kufri works for most ages. Travelling with elderly parents, tell us — Jakhoo Temple involves a steep climb and we will plan around it.

faqs.question: Is Shimla good for a honeymoon?
faqs.answer: It is one of the shortest honeymoons you can take from Delhi, which is why couples pick it when leave is tight. Transport is a private cab rather than a shared coach, and we can add a room upgrade, candlelight dinner or room decoration — just ask when you enquire.

faqs.question: Will we see snowfall in Shimla?
faqs.answer: Possibly, between late December and February, and most likely at Kufri rather than in Shimla town itself. Nobody can promise snow on specific dates — anyone who does is guessing. What we can do is tell you honestly what the forecast looks like before you commit, and plan the Kufri day around it.

faqs.question: Can this Shimla package be customised?
faqs.answer: Yes. Nights, hotel category, vehicle and sightseeing are all adjustable, and the package can start from Chandigarh instead of Delhi if that suits your travel. Tell us your dates, headcount and budget and you will get an itemised quote rather than a fixed menu.
